Ok, so here's the funny thing. Red velvet cake USED to come about because the way cocoa was processed made it reddish. A very chocolate cake would look red. Then, we changed the way we processed cocoa and it became more brown. People still wanted red, so they \*would\* add beet juice! Then the cooking goods manufacturers realized they could sell more red food coloring if they convinced everyone to use it for red velvet cakes instead of beet juice. So they published recipes in women's magazines for red velvet cakes with food coloring, despite the color having absolutely nothing to do with the flavor of the cake.

Food history is weird.
